mapper.sql: mr.id, mr.elder_medication_id, mr.elder_id, e.name as elder_name, mr.medicine_id, mr.medicine_name, mr.dosage, mr.scheduled_time, mr.actual_time, mr.status, mr.executor_id, mr.executor_name, mr.result, mr.notes, mr.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM medication_record mr LEFT JOIN elder e ON mr.elder_id = e.id LEFT JOIN elder_medication em ON mr.elder_medication_id = em.id ORDER BY mr.scheduled_time DESC
SELECT FROM medication_record mr LEFT JOIN elder e ON mr.elder_id = e.id LEFT JOIN elder_medication em ON mr.elder_medication_id = em.id WHERE mr.elder_id = #{elderId} ORDER BY mr.scheduled_time DESC

SELECT FROM medication_record mr LEFT JOIN elder e ON mr.elder_id = e.id LEFT JOIN elder_medication em ON mr.elder_medication_id = em.id WHERE mr.elder_medication_id = #{elderMedicationId} ORDER BY mr.scheduled_time DESC
SELECT FROM medication_record mr LEFT JOIN elder e ON mr.elder_id = e.id LEFT JOIN elder_medication em ON mr.elder_medication_id = em.id WHERE mr.status = #{status} ORDER BY mr.scheduled_time DESC

SELECT FROM medication_record mr LEFT JOIN elder e ON mr.elder_id = e.id LEFT JOIN elder_medication em ON mr.elder_medication_id = em.id WHERE DATE(mr.scheduled_time) = #{date} ORDER BY mr.scheduled_time ASC
SELECT FROM medication_record mr LEFT JOIN elder e ON mr.elder_id = e.id LEFT JOIN elder_medication em ON mr.elder_medication_id = em.id WHERE mr.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medication_record WHERE elder_id = #{elderId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medication_record WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medication_record WHERE DATE(scheduled_time) = #{date}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medication_record WHERE DATE(scheduled_time) = #{date} AND status = #{status}
